subject: what do you mean 'what glitch'
author: drunknnumpty
body:
come on Zom.. you have been living with the white mountain glitch king and you have not seen the Angel Valley one.. in fact I am pretty sure you've hit it in the past while in a room with the usual crew.. I know I have (not on purpose, honest 😇).. and it is a useful glitch if your into playing that way..

not sure if it works on forward as I have only hit it on reverse, but its the last set of bins on the left (?) through the last alleyway short cut before the big jump.. if you hit it you respawn around .1 or .2 of a mile ahead of where you should be..

maybe that should be a future artical from the glitch king himself, identifing all glitches on the tracks, maybe with an arial overview of the track highlighting each glitch point and respawn point.. it would give him a legit excuse to glitch to his hearts content.. 😉

 

theres a thin line between genius and insanity... i think i've fallen off...
